bivalency.definition: n. The quality of being bivalent.

bivalent.definition:
a. having a valence of two or having two valences
a. used of homologous chromosomes associated in pairs in synapsis
bivalent.translation:
a. 二价的
[化] 二价的

bivalents.definition:
plural of bivalent
a. having a valence of two or having two valences
a. used of homologous chromosomes associated in pairs in synapsis
bivalents.translation:
(bivalent 的复数) a. 二价的
[化] 二价的

bivallate.translation: a. 围有两层防护土墙的

bivalve.definition:
n. marine or freshwater mollusks having a soft body with platelike gills enclosed within two shells hinged together
a. used of mollusks having two shells (as clams etc.)
bivalve.translation:
n. 双壳类动物
[医] 两瓣的, 两片的

bivalved.definition:
a. Having two valves, as the oyster and some seed pods;
   bivalve.

bivalves.definition:
plural of bivalve
n. marine or freshwater mollusks having a soft body with platelike gills enclosed within two shells hinged together
a. used of mollusks having two shells (as clams etc.)
bivalves.translation:
(bivalve 的复数) n. 双壳类动物
[医] 两瓣的, 两片的

bivariant system.translation: [化] 双变物系; 双变度物系

bivector.definition:
n. A term made up of the two parts / + /1 /-1, where / and
   /1 are vectors.
bivector.translation: 二重矢量, 二重向量, 平面量

biventral.definition:
a. Having two bellies or protuberances; as, a biventral, or
   digastric, muscle, or the biventral lobe of the cerebellum.

bivicon.translation: 双枪视象管, 双视象管

bivies.translation:
n. [军队俚语]小帐篷；临时营帐；[英国俚语]
vi. [英国俚语]露宿，露营

bivine's method.translation: [医] 比文氏疗法(士的宁中毒疗法)

bivium.definition:
n. One side of an echinoderm, including a pair of ambulacra,
   in distinction from the opposite side (trivium), which includes three
   ambulacra.

bivouac.definition:
n temporary living quarters specially built by the army for soldiers
n a site where people on holiday can pitch a tent
v live in or as if in a tent
bivouac.translation:
n. 野营, 露营, 露营地
vi. 露宿

bivouacked.definition: v live in or as if in a tent

bivouacking.definition:
n the act of encamping and living in tents in a camp
v live in or as if in a tent

bivouacks.translation: 露宿( bivouac的第三人称单数 )

bivouacs.definition:
n temporary living quarters specially built by the army for soldiers
n a site where people on holiday can pitch a tent
v live in or as if in a tent
bivouacs.translation: n. 露营, 野营, 露营地( bivouac的名词复数 )

bivvying.translation: (bivvy 的现在分词) n.<军俚>临时营帐,小帐篷

bivy.translation:
n. [军队俚语]小帐篷；临时营帐；[英国俚语]
vi. [英国俚语]露宿，露营
